ai-random-dev-v2.method: Seeded shuffle, duplicate exclusions, first 24 survivors; no keyword sampling
ai-random-dev-v2.duplicate_rule: Casefolded word equality; 5-word shingle containment >=0.8 or Jaccard >=0.6, minimum 20 shingles
ai-random-dev-v2.comparison_scope: Reviewed quotations and full source text windows from all excluded prior packets; extra reference packet source windows; within-pool duplicate screen
ai-random-dev-v2.limitation: Lexical screen cannot guarantee absence of paraphrases or semantic duplication. Human speech-boundary review still required.
